𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗖𝗛𝗗𝗔𝗬 🔴⚫️

Football returns to the Trentham Foods Stadium tonight as we welcome @SandbachFC_1st for our first home league game of the 2026/27 season.

#UpTheFoley | #NWCFL | #Since1947 https://t.co/CJPmCNQ4GU
Back the ramblers this evening as they travel to @foley_fc in search of back to back wins and that perfect start to the season. https://t.co/sLiMLf7wAx

A brace for @JoeBev97 in the last game confirmed him as @SandbachUtd highest ever scorer, surpassing @James_Kirby10 previous on 54 goals. With a whole season ahead how many can he get!
Congratulations Joe on the fantastic achievement in just two seasons at the ramblers. https://t.co/B5elk2v3Xj

Tonight’s programme vs @SandbachFC_1st 

https://flipbook.so/flip/Sy2YL1VHQ7FRTNi0NFtO https://t.co/jpxwuMRjdr

𝗧𝗘𝗔𝗠 𝗡𝗘𝗪𝗦 | 𝗦𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗛 𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗘𝗗 (𝗛) 🔴⚫

Here’s how Foley line up for tonight’s first home league game of the season as we welcome Sandbach United to the Trentham Foods Stadium.

If you’re coming down tonight, get behind the lads.
Your support means everything.

#UpTheFoley | #TeamNews | #Since1947

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Game under way here at Foley Meir as The Bach look to make 2 wins out of 2 and have the same starting 11 apart from Jack Finney who replaces Saul Shotton in defence.
And we’re off! https://t.co/EenOMAA4ln

3” | A chance for Foley but Jake puts it straight at the keeper.

❤️🖤0-0🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

0 0

Early chance for FM but the shot is straight at Hall who gathers comfortably

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

0 1

Free kick delivered from the right from Mitch Nolan and the ball pings around the 6 yard box and Kieran O’Connell is on hand to finish from a few yards out, get in!

9 mins gone

8’ | Goal Sandbach

The visitors take the lead from a corner ball.

❤️🖤0-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

0 1

Bevan twists and turns in the box gets his shot away but it’s blocked by the wall of defenders in front of him and the ball is cleared

18 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

0 1

Mitch Nolan gets robbed and the FM 9 gets in but his shot is tipped over by Hall for a corner, which he then gathers at the back post

22 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

0 1

Robbie Hatton cuts inside but his shot flies over the bar, remains…..

27 mins gone

24 | Robinson gets a yellow card for a hard tackle on the Sandbach midfielder.

❤️🖤0-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

0 1

FM 8 collects a yellow for a foul on Cope

28 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

1 1

Foley put in a great free kick and it’s finished emphatically at the near post

30 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

1 1

Mitch Nolan delivers a great cross and Hatton gets on the end of it but can’t get his header on target

33 mins gone

GGGGOOOOAAAALLLL

Jake Lovatt nets on his home debut for Foley!

A free kick comes in and he beats his man and volleys home down to the keepers left!

❤️🖤1-1🟡 https://t.co/le9Ht5ED3W

GGGOOOAAALLL

We take the lead! 

Archie claims the goal as it comes off the post and crosses the line!

🖤❤️2-1🟡 https://t.co/lYqTROSIfS

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

2 1

Another needless free kick given away and the free kick is delivered to the far post and a free header somehow is adjudged to have gone over the line. The Bach punished again for not picking their players up at set pieces 

38 mins

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

2 1

Robbie Hatton gets a yellow for a late challenge in the middle of the park

44 mins gone

43’ | Sandbachs number 10 gets a yellow but couldn’t see what for because the sun is in my eyes.

❤️🖤2-1🟡

45’ | We put the ball in the net but unfortunately Jake Lovatt was just offside, in the build up we had another chance but credit to the keeper it was a good save down to his right.

❤️🖤2-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

2 1

Another chance from a corner and Greg Hall with a fine save to his right, FM recycle the ball and draw another save from Hall from the rebound it’s slotted home but the flag goes up and it’s ruled out

In to added time

45’ | Sandbach answer back but the ball comes off the bar from a big header.

❤️🖤2-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

2 1

All action here as Hatton with a free header but it cannons back off the bar and The Bach can’t follow the rebound up.

HT

Half time.

We go into the break the happier side.

A few good chances and we’ve managed to take 2 of them, another 45 to go. https://t.co/UqGy7cbUaa

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

Underway here in the second half and The Bach make 2 changes Saul Shotton and Stan Tatters replace Kieran Nolan and Jordan Stafford

51’ | Sandbach have the first chance of the half which put over the bar from the angle.

❤️🖤2-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

2 1

A fat post cross finds Foley unmarked but he blazes over from inside the 6 yard box should have been the equaliser but it isn’t

52 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Foley get the better of the offside decisions and it’s an emphatic finish from outside the box and it’s a long way back for The Bach now, can they do it….

65 mins gone

GGGGOOOOAAAALLLL!

Lucas Baker with a wonderful finish, a well struck shot from outside the box and over the keeper!

❤️🖤3-1🟡 https://t.co/yAjNhoXE5w

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

The Bach should have pulled one back as the ball flashes across the 6 yard box and then Hatton screws his shot from one side of the 6 yard box to the other when it looked easier to score

71 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Cain on for Cope

71 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Foley gets in down the right but doesn’t get a clean hit and screws his shot wide

75 mins gone

82’ | Sandbachs number 2 gets a yellow for persistent fouling.

❤️🖤3-1🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Kieron O’Connell gets a yellow for a late challenge on the half way line

84 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Callum Hamnett replaced Kyle Foley 

86 mins gone

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 1

Corner comes in and Hatotnnflicks it goalwards and somehow Kieron O’Connell can’t finish it from close range and the keeper gathers. The FM keeper then denies a Barry header as it’s palmed over the bar

90 mins gone

89’ | Fantastic save from Monty down to his right denied Barry.

❤️🖤3-1🟡

90’ | Goal Sandbach

The visitors pull one back late on, a very tense few minutes now.

❤️🖤3-2🟡

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United 

3 2

As Saul Shotton with a fine far post volley into the opposite corner, what a finish, game on!

Into added time

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 2

Could have should have been 3 3 but the keeper pulls off some heroics and saves the day literally.

Full Time

Finishes here 3 2 to Foley Meir as The Bach will rue the many chances they missed and have paid the price for giving soft free kicks away and not picking up players in the box in the 1st half. A disappointing result and have to pick themselves up for Saturdays game vStafford Town

ALL. THREE. POINTS!

Full time and we claim all 3 points tonight and in a fantastic game, credit to Sandbach never once stopped.

We are at home again Saturday when we welcome Shawsbury United.

#UpTheFoley | #NWCFL | #Since1947 https://t.co/OB7shTPMjP
Just to confirm Archie didn’t get the second goal Will Tams was the goal scorer. https://t.co/zq2v5OnWCV

👏 MAN OF THE MATCH 👏

A standout performance from Conner Lawton, who picks up today’s Man of the Match award. 💪

Committed from the first whistle to the last, Conner put in a tireless shift, battled for every ball and was a key figure throughout the game. A well-deserved recognition for an excellent all-round display.

Congratulations, Conner! 👏
